description.value: Dosa Club is a modern South Indian restaurant in Chilliwack offering elevated takes on dosas, tandoori, biryani, and street-food-inspired dishes. The restaurant blends authentic South Indian culinary heritage with a contemporary dining space and attentive service. It accepts online orders and table reservations, serving both the Chilliwack and Abbotsford communities.
